name: Taranaki Civil Defence and Emergency Management Group
description: Adopted its geospatial strategy in May 2021 following stakeholder engagement and technical review. The strategy recorded existing systems and staffing dependencies and proposed a coordinated programme for skills, user needs, interoperable data and technology investment.
